name: grade-book-server
description: Student Grade Management System - Backend API

scripts.test:maintainability:messaging: node --test tests/messageThreadService.test.js tests/messagingAudienceService.test.js tests/messagingMapperAndUtils.test.js tests/messageController.contract.test.js tests/messageValidators.test.js tests/messageRealtimeService.test.js
scripts.quality:maintainability: npm run lint:maintainability && npm run dup:maintainability && npm run coverage:maintainability:check
scripts.lint:maintainability:messaging: eslint routes/messageRoutes.js controllers/messageController.js services/messaging/messagingThreadService.js services/messaging/messagingAudienceService.js services/messaging/messagingMapperService.js services/messaging/messagingRepository.js services/messaging/messagingUtils.js services/messageRealtimeService.js validators/messageValidators.js middleware/schemaValidator.js middleware/errorHandler.js --max-warnings=0 --rule "complexity:[2,10]" --rule "max-lines-per-function:[2,40]"
scripts.dup:maintainability:messaging: jscpd --min-lines 8 --min-tokens 80 --threshold 2 routes/messageRoutes.js controllers/messageController.js services/messaging/messagingThreadService.js services/messaging/messagingAudienceService.js services/messaging/messagingMapperService.js services/messaging/messagingRepository.js services/messageRealtimeService.js validators/messageValidators.js
scripts.coverage:maintainability:messaging: c8 --include=controllers/messageController.js --include=services/messaging/messagingThreadService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingAudienceService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingMapperService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingUtils.js --include=validators/messageValidators.js --include=services/messageRealtimeService.js --reporter=text-summary --reporter=text node --test tests/messageThreadService.test.js tests/messagingAudienceService.test.js tests/messagingMapperAndUtils.test.js tests/messageController.contract.test.js tests/messageValidators.test.js tests/messageRealtimeService.test.js
scripts.coverage:maintainability:messaging:check: c8 --include=controllers/messageController.js --include=services/messaging/messagingThreadService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingAudienceService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingMapperService.js --include=services/messaging/messagingUtils.js --include=validators/messageValidators.js --include=services/messageRealtimeService.js --check-coverage --lines 70 --functions 70 --statements 70 --branches 60 node --test tests/messageThreadService.test.js tests/messagingAudienceService.test.js tests/messagingMapperAndUtils.test.js tests/messageController.contract.test.js tests/messageValidators.test.js tests/messageRealtimeService.test.js
scripts.quality:maintainability:messaging: npm run lint:maintainability:messaging && npm run dup:maintainability:messaging && npm run coverage:maintainability:messaging:check
scripts.quality:maintainability:all: npm run quality:maintainability && npm run quality:maintainability:messaging
scripts.deploy: git add . ; git commit -m "Deployment" ; git push heroku main
scripts.heroku-postbuild: cd client && npm install && npm run build
